title: feat(app-shell): connect your Slack account on the notification settings page, and an admin Slack page in Setup (Part of #34730)
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D62xGLMbyWJaMEVnAMEjTK1)_
Part of #34730
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在接入了 Slack 连接器的部署上，成员在通知设置页可以关联或解除自己的 Slack 账号（先看到提议、再确认）；组织管理员多了一个 Slack 管理页，可以接入或更换本组织的 Slack 令牌、移除接入、查看和移除成员的关联。没有接入 Slack 的部署界面不变。
- 为什么做：这是「Slack 私信通知」专题的第三步（界面部分），让成员和管理员不用调接口就能完成上一步服务端已提供的关联与接入。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是某人关联不上或管理页显示的提示不准，站内信和邮件不受影响；整个改动只在界面层，可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。管理页在设置菜单里还没有入口（入口由服务端提供），需要一张服务端小卡补上，已在下方注明供席位立卡。

## What changes

Step 3 of #34730 (ADR-0013 addendum of 2026-11-19): the console side of the Slack link doors that step 2 (#35789) put on `main`. UI and docs only; no server, spec or skills change. This PR was written in session `session_016WV4czKnDE6hsyXQzB9wB2`.

- **The doors, one client module** (`console/notification-settings/slackDoors.ts`). All nine Slack link routes are called through the host's authenticated fetch (`SchemaRendererContext.apiFetch`), the way the notification settings page already reads its own door; `@objectstack/client` has no method for these routes (measured: no `slack-link`, `slack/account` or `slack/links` in `packages/client` on the base). Each answer is read as served and refused when it is not the door's shape. A refusal is the server's own sentence: `error.userMessage` when the door sends one (only `slackLinkProposalOutdated` today, already in the caller's language), else `error.message`.
- **Notification Settings: the person's Slack section** (`SlackLinkSection.tsx`). Drawn only while the preference door lists the `slack` channel, which it does only where connector-slack is composed. States, each as the `GET /me/slack-link` door answers it:
  - no install (`account: null`): says so, offers nothing;
  - install `revoked`: says Slack refused the organization's token, offers no connect;
  - no link: **Connect Slack** calls `POST …/proposal`;
  - a proposal (`{ state: 'proposed' }`): says a Slack user with the person's verified email was found, never whom, with **Confirm** (`POST …/confirm`) and **Cancel** (`DELETE /me/slack-link`, which removes the proposal row);
  - a confirmed link: the Slack user it names, when, and **Disconnect**.
  - `link: null` from a proposal: the door answers this alike for no verified email, no Slack user with that email, and that Slack user already linked to someone else (step 2's own doc says so), so the page names all three conditions in one sentence and never picks one.
  - After every action, refused or not, the section reads the door again, so a 409 for a missing install, a 502 that marked the token revoked, or a 404 for a replaced proposal is followed by the state as stored. After a refused confirm, **Ask for a new proposal** is offered.
- **Setup's Slack page** (`views/setup/SlackSetupPage.tsx`, component ref `messaging:slack`, so `/apps/setup/component/messaging/slack`). Gated by `setup.write` through `usePermissions().hasCapabilities`, the capability every administrator door asks (`SLACK_ADMIN_CAPABILITY`); without it the page says what is needed and reads no door. It installs or sets again the token (`PUT /slack/account` with `{ token }`) through a password input that starts empty, is emptied as soon as the value is sent, and is never filled from anything (no door answers the token). **Remove Slack** asks first, saying every linked person is told by in-app message and email, then `DELETE /slack/account`. The link list shows each link as served: the person's id, the Slack user only once confirmed (a proposal reads "Proposed, not confirmed yet"), and when it was confirmed; **Remove** per link asks first, then `DELETE /slack/links/:id`. The list is read once, unpaged; when it holds the 10,000 links the store reads at most (`limit: 10000` in `SlackLinkStore.links`), the page says the list may be incomplete. Paging is #35861 (server); this page does not page on its own.
- **i18n**: two new sections, `slackLink` and `slackSetup`, in all eleven built-in packs; `zh-Hant.ts` is regenerated by `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n gen:zh-hant` from `zh-Hans`, not hand-written.
- **Docs**: `content/docs/permissions/administrator-guide.mdx` gains "Deliver notifications by Slack direct message" (no existing page taught Slack DM setup).
- Phone width: both surfaces stack their controls (`flex-col` under `sm`), and the link table scrolls inside its card.

## Verification

Two minutes, on a dev stack with connector-slack composed: open **Notification Settings** as a member; under the matrix a "Slack direct messages" card shows. With no install it says an administrator installs Slack first. As an organization administrator open `/apps/setup/component/messaging/slack`, paste a bot token and choose **Install**: the workspace and "Active" show and the field is empty again. Back as the member, **Connect Slack** shows the proposal without a name; **Confirm** shows the Slack user.

Files to read first, by risk: `SlackSetupPage.tsx` (the token input and the two confirm dialogs), `slackDoors.ts` (what is read from each answer and which sentence a refusal shows), `SlackLinkSection.tsx` (the state after each action is re-read, never inferred).

## Acceptance notes

- **No Setup navigation entry yet.** Setup's entries are contributed by the server package that owns the door (the pattern `CONNECTOR_CREDENTIALS_UI_BUNDLE` in service-automation follows; the shell declares none), so the entry that opens this page belongs in service-messaging: Setup, group `group_integrations`, `componentRef: 'messaging:slack'`, `requiredPermissions: ['setup.write']`, contributed only where the `slack` channel registers. That is a server change, outside this PR's surface; it is named for the seat to file. Until it lands the page is reached by its address, which the docs section names.
- **Link list paging** is #35861; this page reads the list as served and says so at the cap.
- **Person column** shows the user id the door serves; no name is resolved, as ordered.
- The step-2 changeset sentence owed on `messaging.slack_link_removed` (listed as a topic on every deployment) belongs in `@objectstack/service-messaging`'s changeset, outside this PR's surface; it is not carried here.
- `ui/AGENTS.md` #2 asks for a package README update for features; `@object-ui/app-shell`'s README documents no individual page, so none was added.
- Soft size: 1,718 net added lines (561 of them the eleven locale packs), about 1.9 times the order's 900, under the 2,700 hard stop.
